subject.title: refactor: unify the embedded-agent fallback run-entry across all four pipelines

question: Should this broad agent-runtime consolidation proceed once the contributor provides real after-fix evidence for the four migrated pipelines, or should maintainers require narrower staged extraction first?
rationale: The patch intentionally centralizes behavior whose differences include fallback eligibility, abort projection, terminal lifecycle handling, and session reconciliation; test-only evidence cannot settle whether those path-specific production contracts remain intact.

options.title: Require focused runtime proof
options.body: Request redacted after-fix terminal or log evidence for representative channel, command, maintenance, and follow-up executions, then review the refreshed merge result.

options.title: Accept test-only refactor evidence
options.body: Merge based on the reported owning-suite coverage and static gates while accepting the remaining cross-path runtime uncertainty.

options.title: Stage the extraction
options.body: Split the change into smaller pipeline migrations if maintainers prefer to reduce the blast radius of a shared runtime owner.

recommendation.title: Require focused runtime proof
recommendation.body: Request redacted after-fix terminal or log evidence for representative channel, command, maintenance, and follow-up executions, then review the refreshed merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author is the clearest available contact for the intended behavior map and for producing the requested runtime proof.
